shared_operations.name: resolveAuthenticatedActor
shared_operations.Plain English: Turn a valid provider session or system credential into the trusted Workin Ants actor context used by server-side operations.
shared_operations.Boundary: Authentication ends at actor resolution. Feature Modules still decide what the actor is trying to do.
shared_operations.Build rule: Implement once as request middleware plus a typed actor context. Prohibit feature-local current-user helpers.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: authenticateActor; requireAuthenticatedActor; getAuthenticatedActor; getAuthenticatedActorContext; Authentication/session resolution; Authenticated actor context

shared_operations.name: authorizeResourceAction
shared_operations.Plain English: Decide whether an authenticated actor may perform a named action on a protected resource in platform, organization, participant, or ownership scope.
shared_operations.Boundary: Role interprets permission. Hiring owns organization membership; Messaging owns ThreadParticipant. Read owner facts only; never absorb foreign lifecycles.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose a typed decision API and matching route/RLS enforcement. Do not embed business readiness or entitlement policy.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: authorizeAction; authorizeDomainAction; authorizeScopedAction; authorizeBusinessAction; Authorization decision; contextual ownership check; organization-role authorization; thread-participant authorization

shared_operations.name: queryOwnerFacts
shared_operations.Plain English: Read the minimum relationship or ownership facts needed by another Module without transferring lifecycle ownership.
shared_operations.Boundary: Owner-specific queries may exist independently. No mandatory universal DTO, generic facts repository, or cross-domain Prisma reader.
shared_operations.Build rule: Define small owner-specific DTOs. Reject a universal polymorphic repository or cross-domain direct Prisma reads.

shared_operations.name: resolveCustomerActor
shared_operations.Plain English: Resolve an authenticated User into the CustomerProfile that acts as the commercial buyer.
shared_operations.Boundary: Resolve/provision CustomerProfile for new buyer actions. User stays account/audit identity; destinations own historical cutover.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide an idempotent lookup/provisioning interface for CustomerProfile before new buyer actions. Destination owners implement required buyer references and historical cutover; existing User foreign keys do not waive the semantic requirement.

shared_operations.name: resolveEntitlement
shared_operations.Plain English: Return the effective feature, quota, waiver, boost, commission, priority, or perk for a specific actor track and entitlement key.
shared_operations.Boundary: Consuming Modules own how the result affects their action and historical snapshots. No local premium booleans.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use typed keys and typed values, effective dates, grant precedence, reason codes, and evidence references.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: evaluateEntitlement; lookupEntitlement; getActiveEntitlement; getEffectiveEntitlements; resolveEffectiveEntitlement; Entitlement lookup

shared_operations.name: consumeMeteredEntitlement
shared_operations.Plain English: Atomically confirm that a limited entitlement can be used and record the permitted quantity as immutable usage proof.
shared_operations.Boundary: The source Module defines when the business event actually counts; Track owns usage periods, counters, and receipts.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use one transaction, idempotency key, immutable TrackUsageEvent, and rebuildable counter projection.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: recordUsageEvent; Usage metering; consumeUsageAtomically; atomicCounterIncrement

shared_operations.name: recordConsentProof
shared_operations.Plain English: Persist version-specific evidence that a User accepted a particular consent, disclosure, authorization, or agreement.
shared_operations.Boundary: ConsentLog proves acceptance; it does not grant the downstream permission or replace contextual consent records.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose one acceptance command with exact type, version, acceptedAt, and minimized request evidence.

shared_operations.name: queryConsentProof
shared_operations.Plain English: Return whether the required consent type and version was accepted, including the proof reference.
shared_operations.Boundary: The consuming Module determines whether that proof is sufficient for its current action.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return proof ID, type, version, acceptedAt, and validity status; never duplicate consent tables in consumers.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: lookupConsentProof; getConsentProof; resolveConsentProof; verifyConsentProof; Consent proof lookup

shared_operations.name: resolveActiveConsentVersion
shared_operations.Plain English: Select the currently applicable consent or disclosure version for type, locale, jurisdiction, and effective date.
shared_operations.Boundary: Material-change and re-consent policy remain Consent-owned.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use an immutable version catalog with effective dates, content hash, locale, and jurisdiction.

shared_operations.name: presentStandaloneConsent
shared_operations.Plain English: Render a high-risk disclosure separately and submit its acceptance through the canonical consent command.
shared_operations.Boundary: The owning workflow supplies context; Consent owns version rendering and generic acceptance proof.
shared_operations.Build rule: Build one reusable shell with version lookup, accessibility, evidence capture, and no provider-specific side effects.

shared_operations.name: evaluateComplianceHold
shared_operations.Plain English: Return active reusable stop signs that apply to a target and requested action.
shared_operations.Boundary: Evaluate current target/action against all applicable active Holds. Cached association/released Hold is not permission. Consumer owns lifecycle consequence.
shared_operations.Build rule: Query by target type/ID and action; return safe reason codes, hold IDs, scope, and expiration.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: checkComplianceHold; checkActiveComplianceHold; evaluateComplianceHolds; applyComplianceHoldGate

shared_operations.name: requestComplianceHold
shared_operations.Plain English: Ask the hold owner to create an authoritative platform stop sign for a target.
shared_operations.Boundary: Exactly one typed primary target plus scope, reason, requester/system, source evidence and replay identity. No local blocked flag.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use a typed, idempotent command with target, reason, source, evidence references, requested scope, and actor.

shared_operations.name: releaseComplianceHold
shared_operations.Plain English: Ask the hold owner to release an existing hold after the source condition is resolved.
shared_operations.Boundary: Require source-owner release evidence plus Hold authority. Only Hold changes Hold status. No universal readiness auto-release.
shared_operations.Build rule: Require hold ID, source decision reference, actor, reason, and idempotency key; append audit proof.

shared_operations.name: requireStepUpForSensitiveAction
shared_operations.Plain English: Require fresh MFA, passkey, or equivalent assurance before a high-risk action proceeds.
shared_operations.Boundary: Feature Modules declare which actions require step-up; Identity owns challenge, expiry, attempt, and assurance-session lifecycles.
shared_operations.Build rule: Bind SensitiveActionSession to actor, action, target, assurance level, and short expiry; enforce server-side.

shared_operations.name: returnDecisionResult
shared_operations.Plain English: Offer optional decision-result envelope conventions without centralizing a participating Module’s policy or replacing its result vocabulary.
shared_operations.Boundary: Optional envelope conventions only. Preserve owner enums; do not coerce unavailable/review-required into generic allow/deny.
shared_operations.Build rule: Offer common envelope fields for reasons, evidence, warnings, evaluatedAt, policy version, expiry, and next action where appropriate. Preserve owner decision enums and unavailable/review-required distinctions; no mandatory universal allow/deny DTO.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: buildReadinessDecision; composeReadinessDecision; returnReadinessDecision; evaluateReadinessResult; evaluateReadiness response shape; Access-denial translation

shared_operations.name: evaluateProfessionalReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Determine whether a ProfessionalProfile may perform a named selling action.
shared_operations.Boundary: The action-to-gate composition remains Professional Eligibility policy; underlying verification, healthcare, financial, entitlement, and hold truth stays external.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose action-specific decisions such as publish_offering, respond_to_gig, and participate_in_order.

shared_operations.name: resolveVerificationRequirements
shared_operations.Plain English: Return the verification checks required by accepted taxonomy and target context.
shared_operations.Boundary: Requirement resolution does not assert that the checks are satisfied.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return requirement IDs, check types, severity, applicability, expiry expectations, and owning evidence.

shared_operations.name: evaluateVerificationReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Determine whether the required verification checks and credentials are currently satisfied.
shared_operations.Boundary: Consumers must not reconstruct readiness from badges or raw provider statuses.
shared_operations.Build rule: Evaluate VerificationRequirement and VerificationCheck truth; return a DecisionResult with safe evidence references.

shared_operations.name: evaluateFinancialReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Determine KYC, tax-profile, payout-account, available-balance, and financial-restriction readiness.
shared_operations.Boundary: Financial readiness may expose tax-specific fulfillment action/result. Generic financial readiness cannot independently clear prize/tax fulfillment.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return separate readiness dimensions and reasons rather than one opaque boolean.

shared_operations.name: evaluateHealthcareReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Determine whether healthcare-lane, provider, BAA, and data-boundary requirements are satisfied.
shared_operations.Boundary: Readiness/BAA/vendor evaluation remains separate from SH-130 privileged payload access.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return healthcare-lane, provider, BAA, and data-boundary readiness with policy version. SH-130 separately evaluates privileged protected-payload access and handling/redaction; readiness never grants that access.

shared_operations.name: evaluateJobCompliance
shared_operations.Plain English: Evaluate a versioned Job snapshot against jurisdiction-aware employment-posting rules.
shared_operations.Boundary: Result vocabulary: allowed, denied, warning, review_required, unavailable. Remediation metadata is not a separate result truth.
shared_operations.Build rule: Accept canonical Job input and rule-set version; return allowed, denied, warning, review_required, or unavailable with findings, remediation metadata, and snapshot hash.

shared_operations.name: resolveTaxonomyRequirements
shared_operations.Plain English: Translate accepted Domain, Category, and Tag combinations into verification, healthcare, location, license, or sensitivity requirements.
shared_operations.Boundary: Only approved represented trigger families. No arbitrary-tag inference or hardcoded consumer requirement lists.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return requirement identifiers, owner Module, trigger source, severity, and applicability.

shared_operations.name: validateTaxonomyAssignment
shared_operations.Plain English: Validate canonical Domain, Category, Tag, hierarchy, active status, and entity-assignment compatibility.
shared_operations.Boundary: Taxonomy validates canonical compatibility; contextual source owner mutates its own assignment joins.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose normalized validation errors and canonical IDs; prevent local tag cleaners and taxonomy copies.

shared_operations.name: evaluatePublicReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Return whether source truth may appear in a specified public or protected discovery surface.
shared_operations.Boundary: Search must not rebuild professional, Offering, Job, candidate privacy, healthcare, verification, moderation, or hold policy.
shared_operations.Build rule: Require owner-issued decisions and source version; Search only composes them into index, update, or removal.

shared_operations.name: authorizeOrderEntitlement
shared_operations.Plain English: Confirm that an authoritative Order currently permits a requested booking, file, download, playback, or delivery action.
shared_operations.Boundary: Order remains transaction truth; delivery Modules retain their own grant and usage policy.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return Order state, participant relationship, qualifying line/item, refund/dispute effects, and decision evidence.

shared_operations.name: authorizeContextualResourceAccess
shared_operations.Plain English: Return the business-context decision required before Media, video, location, resume, agreement, or digital access is granted.
shared_operations.Boundary: Actor/resource/context/action-bound contextual decision. Media still independently applies Media gates; no universal access oracle.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use owner-specific actor/resource/context/action-bound implementations. Media independently applies its gates; prohibit a generic service that infers authorization for all domains.

shared_operations.name: resolveLocationReveal
shared_operations.Plain English: Decide whether an exact private location may be decrypted and shown to a particular viewer in an Order or Booking context.
shared_operations.Boundary: Exact service location is private by default. Location Safety makes a fresh server-side reveal decision only for the Professional/provider legitimately performing the active in-person service, limited to the service-performance window. Source Modules own source location facts; Booking/Order/payment facts are inputs, not reveal authorization. Completion ends service justification; cancellation, refund, or dispute revokes/masks access; rescheduling re-evaluates the current relationship without a second reveal lifecycle. Public, Search, and map consumers never receive exact location.
shared_operations.Build rule: Return reveal eligibility, permitted precision, expiry/revocation context, and LocationReveal proof under Location Safety. Do not build a Booking/Order reveal lifecycle or reveal flags, frontend/cached reveal authorization, or public exact-coordinate fallback.

shared_operations.name: applyFuzzyPublicLocation
shared_operations.Plain English: Generate, update, or invalidate an approved approximate public location without exposing exact coordinates.
shared_operations.Boundary: Keep generation/update/invalidation semantics here. SH-131 performs side-effect-free current projection reads. No consumer-side fuzzing or exact leakage.
shared_operations.Build rule: Produce a stable fuzzy projection with coordinates/area, radius, expiry, and source version without exact-location leakage. SH-131 performs side-effect-free current reads. No consumer-side fuzzing or read-triggered refresh recursion.

shared_operations.name: appendAuditEvent
shared_operations.Plain English: Append generic proof that an important actor or system action occurred.
shared_operations.Boundary: Preserve actor/action/target/outcome/correlation and safe metadata; support system attribution. Audit does not replace business state.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose an insert-only command with actor, action, target, outcome, request ID, and schema-validated safe metadata.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: recordAuditEvent; writeAuditEvent; Generic audit event append

shared_operations.name: recordSensitiveAccess
shared_operations.Plain English: Append proof that protected data or access credentials were viewed, issued, downloaded, denied, blocked, or redacted.
shared_operations.Boundary: Generic sensitive-access vocabulary stays Audit-owned; healthcare-specific decision enums do not become universal authorization truth.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use Audit-owned generic sensitive-access actions/outcomes, target references, request context, and minimized payloads. Reconcile the Healthcare-specific AccessAuditLog decision field before persistence commitment; its enum is not the generic authorization contract.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: appendSensitiveAccessLog; appendSensitiveAccessAudit; writeSensitiveAccessLog; Sensitive-access logging

shared_operations.name: appendDomainLifecycleEvent
shared_operations.Plain English: Append an immutable domain-owned transition record transactionally with the owning aggregate change.
shared_operations.Owner: Shared persistence mechanism; each domain owns truth
shared_operations.Boundary: OrderEvent, BookingEvent, JobInterviewEvent, UserSecurityEvent, PointLedgerEntry, and similar records must not be merged.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide insert-only repository conventions, actor/time capture, optional hash support, and transaction hooks.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: appendDomainEvent; Domain event ledger append; appendDomainLedgerEntry (mechanism only); recordDomainAccessEvent (domain-specific variant)

shared_operations.name: createRequestContext
shared_operations.Plain English: Create and propagate request, correlation, trace, environment, and actor identifiers across synchronous and asynchronous work.
shared_operations.Boundary: Only safe identifiers may enter telemetry; domain payloads remain source-owned.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use async context propagation and include correlation IDs in provider calls, jobs, audit requests, and logs.

shared_operations.name: writeStructuredLog
shared_operations.Plain English: Emit consistent machine-readable operational logs.
shared_operations.Boundary: Logs diagnose execution and must not become business or compliance truth.
shared_operations.Build rule: Implement one logger with controlled fields, levels, environments, redaction, and request context.

shared_operations.name: sanitizeTelemetryMetadata
shared_operations.Plain English: Remove secrets, PHI, payment data, credentials, raw documents, and unnecessary personal data from telemetry and audit metadata.
shared_operations.Owner: Observability/Ops mechanism; Audit controls Audit payload acceptance
shared_operations.Boundary: Reuse sanitation implementation without allowing Ops to define retained Audit evidence or source sensitivity policy.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use allowlists, sensitive-key detection, truncation, safe serialization, and test fixtures for prohibited fields.

shared_operations.name: captureException
shared_operations.Plain English: Send an exception to the monitoring provider with safe grouping and request context.
shared_operations.Boundary: Feature Modules provide operation context but must not instantiate separate Sentry clients.
shared_operations.Build rule: Wrap the provider once; apply sampling, release/environment tags, redaction, and correlation IDs.

shared_operations.name: emitMetric
shared_operations.Plain English: Publish counters, gauges, timings, queue depth, retries, and failure rates through one metrics client.
shared_operations.Boundary: Metric semantics remain operational; avoid user-level high-cardinality dimensions.
shared_operations.Build rule: Define a naming registry, allowed dimensions, cardinality limits, and alert ownership.

shared_operations.name: recordIntegrationFailure
shared_operations.Plain English: Persist normalized operational evidence that a provider, worker, or integration failed or degraded.
shared_operations.Boundary: The owning Module still writes any business-relevant failure status. IntegrationFailure does not replace domain truth.
shared_operations.Build rule: Accept provider, operation, source reference, safe diagnostics, retryability, request ID, and incident linkage.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: appendOperationalFailure; recordOperationalFailure; reportIntegrationFailure; Operational failure recording

shared_operations.name: recordQueueTelemetry
shared_operations.Plain English: Record queue claim, attempt, heartbeat, duration, retry, completion, and dead-letter state.
shared_operations.Owner: Observability/Ops telemetry; shared queue infrastructure executes
shared_operations.Boundary: Queue execution observations are operational evidence only. Never replace owner workflow state or invent local queue/failure ledgers.
shared_operations.Build rule: Instrument the shared worker runner and expose QueueJob/metrics without custom per-Module queue ledgers.

shared_operations.name: checkServiceHealth
shared_operations.Plain English: Return standardized healthy, degraded, unavailable, or delayed status for an application component or dependency.
shared_operations.Owner: Observability / Ops coordinates; owner supplies check
shared_operations.Boundary: Each owner defines what health means for its source truth and provider.
shared_operations.Build rule: Register typed health checks with bounded timeouts, no sensitive payloads, and readiness/liveness separation.

shared_operations.name: correlateOpsIncident
shared_operations.Plain English: Group related failures, system events, queue signals, and alerts into one operational incident.
shared_operations.Boundary: Business Modules must not create competing generic incident systems.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use correlation IDs, grouping rules, severity, assignment, mitigation, and resolution transitions.

shared_operations.name: requestNotification
shared_operations.Plain English: Submit a business, security, compliance, or operational alert through one canonical delivery interface.
shared_operations.Boundary: Generic alerts use Notification. Identity challenge/OTP transport remains inside Identity authentication protocol. Delivery is not business/legal completion.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use a typed command with recipients, template key, sensitivity, priority, variables, idempotency key, and action route.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: sendNotification; enqueueNotification; dispatchNotification; dispatchWorkflowNotification; requestNotificationDelivery; Notification request

shared_operations.name: renderNotificationTemplate
shared_operations.Plain English: Render validated, localized, channel-specific content from a named/versioned template.
shared_operations.Boundary: Legal or business owners approve meaning and versions; Notification enforces safe variables and channel limits.
shared_operations.Build rule: Centralize template rendering and variable schemas; prohibit per-Module provider dispatch and ad hoc HTML builders.

shared_operations.name: resolveNotificationRecipients
shared_operations.Plain English: Resolve domain-owned recipient groups into concrete User IDs while retaining delivery routing in Notification.
shared_operations.Owner: Source owner resolves eligibility; Notification routes
shared_operations.Boundary: Source relationships/settings decide eligible recipients; Notification deduplicates/routes/fans out. Distinguish empty, unavailable, unauthorized.
shared_operations.Build rule: Expose owner-specific recipient queries and let Notification handle dedupe, channel preference, and fan-out.

shared_operations.name: executeIdempotentCommand
shared_operations.Plain English: Ensure a retried command produces one business effect and can replay the original result.
shared_operations.Boundary: Each Module defines semantic command identity, conflict rules, and valid replay behavior.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use request fingerprint, idempotency key, atomic claim/result persistence, transaction boundary, and expiry policy.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: withIdempotency; applyIdempotencyKey; enforceIdempotentCommand; idempotentCommandExecution; runIdempotentCommand

shared_operations.name: deduplicateDomainEvent
shared_operations.Plain English: Prevent one published domain event from causing the same consumer-side effect more than once.
shared_operations.Owner: Platform event infrastructure; consumer owns inbox/effect
shared_operations.Boundary: One inbox mechanism, but consumer owns handler/version/effect identity and transactional recovery.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use transactional inbox claims keyed by event ID plus handler/version, with idempotent completion.

shared_operations.name: publishDomainEvent
shared_operations.Plain English: Reliably publish a versioned domain event after the source-of-truth transaction commits.
shared_operations.Boundary: The source Module owns event names, payload meaning, privacy filtering, and emission conditions.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use a transactional outbox, stable envelope, aggregate version, correlation/causation IDs, retries, and schema versioning.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: publishOutboxEvent; publishTransactionalDomainEvent; transactional outbox; publishDomainEvent

shared_operations.name: enqueueReliableJob
shared_operations.Plain English: Persist asynchronous work with correlation, retries, leases, and visible terminal failure.
shared_operations.Boundary: The owning Module defines payload, completion meaning, and business state; QueueJob is operational only.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide one queue client/worker shell with idempotency, lease, heartbeat, dead-letter, and telemetry.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: enqueueRetryableJob; enqueueBackgroundJob; enqueueIdempotentJob; enqueueDomainJob; enqueueReliableWork

shared_operations.name: executeRetryWithBackoff
shared_operations.Plain English: Retry transient technical failures while stopping on permanent, unsafe, or manual-review failures.
shared_operations.Boundary: Retry technical retryable failures only. Terminal business reopening, replacement, or compensation requires explicit owner command.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use bounded exponential backoff, jitter, max attempts, timeout, circuit breaking, and dead-letter routing.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: retryQueuedWork; executeWithRetry; runQueuedJobWithRetry; runRetryableProviderOperation; processQueueRetryAndDeadLetter

shared_operations.name: orchestrateWorkflowSteps
shared_operations.Plain English: Persist and execute a multi-step cross-Module sequence without taking ownership of participant truth.
shared_operations.Boundary: Booking, Order, Privacy, Moderation, and Dispute sequences retain separate run/step semantics.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide reusable run/step, dependency, retry, compensation, correlation, and acknowledgment primitives.

shared_operations.name: reconcileWorkflowStatus
shared_operations.Plain English: Aggregate child-step outcomes into the owning workflow’s parent status.
shared_operations.Boundary: Completed, partial, failed, retained, skipped, or compensated meanings remain workflow-specific.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide deterministic aggregation hooks; never encode all domain statuses in one generic table.

shared_operations.name: acquireAggregateLock
shared_operations.Plain English: Serialize conflicting commands against the same aggregate or constrained resource.
shared_operations.Boundary: The Module defines lock key, conflicting actions, and safe retry behavior.
shared_operations.Build rule: Prefer Postgres row/advisory locks or serializable transactions; prohibit in-memory mutexes for distributed work.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: acquireDomainLock; acquireContextLock; lockMutableAggregate; lockAggregateForTransition; concurrencyGuard; acquireResourceLock

shared_operations.name: withOptimisticConcurrency
shared_operations.Plain English: Reject stale writes when the expected aggregate version or updatedAt value no longer matches.
shared_operations.Boundary: Use opaque owner-issued expected concurrency token; owner defines backing version/stale behavior. No unsafe read-then-write fallback.
shared_operations.Build rule: Accept an opaque owner-issued expected concurrency token and apply the owner’s compare-and-set/version strategy. Owner defines stale-conflict behavior and exposed version details; no unsafe read-then-write fallback.

shared_operations.name: transitionLifecycleState
shared_operations.Plain English: Apply reusable state-machine plumbing while preserving each Module’s transition graph and invariants.
shared_operations.Owner: Shared mechanism; lifecycle owner supplies policy
shared_operations.Boundary: No generic policy table may own Order, Booking, Job, Review, Hold, or other lifecycle semantics.
shared_operations.Build rule: Provide transition validation, transactional update, event hook, and explicit reason/actor metadata.

shared_operations.name: claimWorkItem
shared_operations.Plain English: Prevent multiple reviewers or workers from simultaneously owning the same manual-review item.
shared_operations.Boundary: Reviewer eligibility, assignment, lease duration, escalation, and decision remain with the review owner.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use transactional claim/lease, optimistic versioning, reassignment, expiry, and audit hooks.

shared_operations.name: runDeadlineExpiration
shared_operations.Plain English: Find time-bound records whose deadline passed and invoke their owner-defined expiration transition.
shared_operations.Boundary: Gig, grant, subscription, hold, booking, and session expiration rules remain local.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use cursor batching, owner command dispatch, idempotency, retries, and clock-controlled tests.

shared_operations.name: executeAtomicReservation
shared_operations.Plain English: Atomically reserve scarce value or inventory so concurrent commands cannot overspend or over-allocate it.
shared_operations.Boundary: Points, reward inventory, funds, slots, and other reserves retain domain-specific sufficiency and release rules.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use a transaction plus row/range lock, reservation proof where needed, and idempotent release/commit.

shared_operations.name: consumeCounterAtomically
shared_operations.Plain English: Increment a bounded counter and enforce its maximum without concurrency races.
shared_operations.Boundary: Usage period, maximum, quantity, reversal, and denial semantics remain with the owning Module.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use atomic upsert/compare-and-update or row lock and return a receipt containing before/after/remaining.

shared_operations.name: acquireIntervalLock
shared_operations.Plain English: Reserve a time interval and reject prohibited overlap.
shared_operations.Owner: Booking & Calendar policy over shared Postgres mechanism
shared_operations.Boundary: Booking owns active interval and conflict policy; Job Interview may consume a distinct scheduling interface but not BookingSlotLock truth.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use range types/exclusion constraints and transactionally create the booking hold or lock.

shared_operations.name: verifyProviderWebhookSignature
shared_operations.Plain English: Verify raw webhook bytes, timestamp, and provider signature before accepting an external event.
shared_operations.Owner: Shared integration-security shell; provider adapter supplies algorithm
shared_operations.Boundary: Provider secrets, accepted endpoints, algorithms, tolerance, and event types remain adapter-local.
shared_operations.Build rule: Build one raw-body verifier contract and provider implementations; reject before parsing or side effects.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: verifyWebhookSignature; verifyProviderWebhook; verifyWebhookSignature; Webhook signature verification

shared_operations.name: deduplicateProviderEvent
shared_operations.Plain English: Atomically claim a provider event so the same callback cannot repeat side effects.
shared_operations.Boundary: Partition by provider/account/domain/event. Receipt claim does not equal completed effect; retain retry/recovery evidence.
shared_operations.Build rule: Partition by provider, account, domain, and event identity, with payload hash and owner-specific effect/recovery results. Receipt claim is distinct from completed effect; transactionally protect the owner effect without suppressing unfinished recovery.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: Provider-event deduplication; verifyAndDeduplicateProviderWebhook (dedupe portion)

shared_operations.name: translateProviderStatus
shared_operations.Plain English: Convert provider-native statuses and errors into the owning Module’s canonical result and transition vocabulary.
shared_operations.Boundary: Payment, calendar, video, verification, subscription, notification, storage, and fulfillment mappings must not be centralized.
shared_operations.Build rule: Require explicit mapping tables, unknown-status handling, mapping version, and normalized result envelope.
shared_operations.Candidate aliases / narrower variants: Provider-status translation; translateProviderResult; translateProviderFailure (operational mapping variant)

shared_operations.name: reconcileProviderState
shared_operations.Plain English: Compare Workin Ants source truth with provider state and safely repair missed or inconsistent effects.
shared_operations.Owner: Each provider-owning Module using shared worker framework
shared_operations.Boundary: Only the owner decides which discrepancies can be repaired automatically.
shared_operations.Build rule: Use pagination/cursors, time windows, dry run, discrepancy report, idempotent repair commands, and incident creation.

shared_operations.name: captureProviderSnapshot
shared_operations.Plain English: Preserve a timestamped, immutable representation of provider state needed for explanation, support, or audit.
shared_operations.Boundary: The fields and domain meaning remain adapter- and Module-specific.

shared_operations.name: getCustomerAggregateView
shared_operations.Plain English: Assemble a customer-facing commerce/history dashboard without copying source lifecycles into CustomerProfile.
shared_operations.Owner: Customer application facade; source Modules retain facts
shared_operations.Boundary: Customer may federate authorized owner queries with freshness/partial-failure state. No durable foreign lifecycle mirror by default.
shared_operations.Build rule: Compose authorized owner queries in a Customer application facade with source links, freshness, and partial/unavailable outcomes. No durable foreign lifecycle mirror by default.

shared_operations.name: requestMediaAccess
shared_operations.Plain English: Composite short-lived protected-media access request after contextual-owner and Media approval.
shared_operations.Boundary: Composite short-lived protected-media access request after contextual-owner and Media approval. Contextual owner decides why access is permitted; Media decides readiness, grants, TTL, signing, and file proof. Not duplicate of: SH-026 contextual permission, SH-088 grant plumbing, SH-087 internal signing.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: feature-local signed-URL endpoint, permanent private URL, second public Media signer.

shared_operations.name: getMediaReadiness
shared_operations.Plain English: Side-effect-free safe read of upload/scan/processing readiness.
shared_operations.Boundary: Side-effect-free safe read of upload/scan/processing readiness. Contextual suitability, attachment role, publication, and entitlement remain outside Media readiness.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: feature-local scan/readiness interpretation or treating `ready` as access authorization.

shared_operations.name: queryActiveModerationRestriction
shared_operations.Plain English: Current moderation/legal restriction query for typed target/action.
shared_operations.Boundary: Current moderation/legal restriction query for typed target/action. Target owner decides/executes supported local lifecycle effect; ComplianceHold remains independent.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: consumers directly reading moderation cases or reconstructing legal restriction state.

shared_operations.name: evaluateHealthcareAdminAccess
shared_operations.Plain English: Healthcare-specific protected-payload access and handling/redaction decision.
shared_operations.Boundary: Healthcare-specific protected-payload access and handling/redaction decision. Role retains general authority; resource owner retains contextual entitlement, effect execution, and redaction execution.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: universal healthcare permission engine or misuse SH-020 readiness as privileged-data access.

shared_operations.name: getPublicLocationProjection
shared_operations.Plain English: Side-effect-free read of current approved fuzzy public location.
shared_operations.Boundary: Side-effect-free read of current approved fuzzy public location. Location owns precision/freshness; source owns private original; Search/public consumer owns permitted presentation behavior. Distinct from SH-028: SH-028 produces/updates/invalidates; SH-131 reads.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: consumer-side fuzzing, exact-coordinate fallback, or read-triggered refresh recursion.

shared_operations.name: enforceRateLimit
shared_operations.Plain English: Distributed atomic request-admission/rate-limit execution.
shared_operations.Boundary: Distributed atomic request-admission/rate-limit execution. Caller specifies key scope, action, window, limit, bypass, retry response and failure posture. Distinct from: SH-006 commercial usage metering, SH-044 idempotency, SH-051 locking, SH-057 generic counter increments.
shared_operations.Build rule: Do not build: per-feature generic rate-limit infrastructure. Do not use rate limiting as commercial metering or include raw sensitive identifiers in diagnostics. Track separately owns paid usage quotas.
